chapter: Handy's Louisiana Shakers and Pelican Garden
title: Don Albert takes Alvin Alcorn; David Jones
summary: Don Albert hired away Alcorn and others; David Jones was his top player.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: When I come back here, Don Albert took Alvin from me. He had a regular job, I think. Alvin Alcorn went with him. And a trombone player. He went with him. And somebody just kept streaming out of the band. And he left and went with Don Albert.
Who was your top player on in the... I don't remember.
He had a music school here. He still got one in California. Yeah, he's got a... He was...
